entities.summary: Turkish Petroleum Company, a political institution in Iraq during Late Ottoman Iraq and Tanzimat (1899–1914). Grew from Tanzimat Reforms in Iraq. Led to the emergence of Turkish Petroleum Company formed to explore Iraqi oil.
